title: F-PM08D7 restricted fixed-weir transactional runtime current-canonical admission

scope.physics_added: restricted fixed-weir surface-water storage, supply, drainage attribution and weir discharge on explicitly feature-active columns

invariants.basis: The capability is composed into the existing canonical kernel/runtime and introduces no alternate SWAP kernel.
The fixed-weir process and runtime wrapper contain no file-format, path or file-I/O ownership; F-VQ59 no-hidden-I/O checks passed.
Fixed-weir parameters, forcing, committed state, numerical configuration, observations and transaction results remain separate typed data categories.
Surface-water storage is persistent only in the feature-active fixed-weir optional-state subtype; inactive B1.10 columns retain the base state layout.
No SAVE or COMMON process-owned persistent scratch is introduced; temporary solve data remain call-local.
The canonical MultiSWAP dispatcher is bit-preserved and the feature state is column-local, retaining batching/layout freedom.
Mismatch and infeasible fixed-weir trials fail closed and leave committed state and revision unchanged; accepted trials commit exactly once.
Existing retry, restart and recomputation contracts are retained; PM08D7 does not make trial state authoritative over committed state.
Qualification exercises explicit generic t0,t1 intervals and introduces no day, month, year or midnight requirement.
Groundwater coupling-window semantics are untouched by the surface-water feature.
Canonical transaction and coupling infrastructure remains in place; the feature composes through existing runtime transaction services.
The admitted groundwater head/flux interface contract is not modified.
Accepted fixed-weir routes require complete hard water balance. Supply is external input, weir discharge is external output, internal drainage is not double-counted, and rejected trials roll back.
Groundwater interface-sensitivity outputs and their transport are untouched.
The capability introduces no additional predictor/corrector or full-column groundwater coupling runs.
F-VQ59 qualified explicit per-column committed-state ownership, backend-context clearing and MultiSWAP column isolation while preserving the canonical dispatcher.
MODFLOW cell fractions and tile aggregation remain runtime/coupler concerns outside this capability.
The optional deep-vadose component boundary is untouched.
No deep-vadose/direct-coupling transition or stored-water transfer semantics are changed.
The common soil-water solver interfaces remain intact; PM08D7 adds no alternative soil-water solver implementation.
Existing soil-water, drainage, transaction and runtime services are reused instead of duplicating SWAP physics.
The fixed-weir process/runtime uses typed runtime/solver contracts and does not expose HeadCalc internal arrays to other modules.
Fixed-weir physical parameters and forcing are separate from the fixed-weir numerical configuration; no performance policy silently changes physical options.
The fixed-weir scalar solve has a bounded bisection iteration limit and fail-closed rollback on infeasible/non-admitted routes; no mass-conservation relaxation is allowed.
The canonical reference tree and legacy HeadCalc source remain bit-preserved; full reference capability is not removed or weakened.
Surface-water observations, transaction outcomes, context status and failure routes remain explicit and test-visible in runtime diagnostics/results.
Fixed-weir persistent state is present only for columns using the fixed-weir optional-state layout; inactive columns do not pay that state footprint.
Tile fractions, MODFLOW mapping and other system-composition relationships remain outside the SWAP kernel.
No .swp, path, direct-MODFLOW, midnight or one-day assumptions are introduced in the process/runtime implementation.
F-CI52 explicitly rechecks all 30 architecture invariants against the exact current-canonical composition and F-VQ59 evidence.

admission_holds: promotion is forbidden if integration/f-ci-canonical moves away from eba90d79010b095b6556e93bd8b77a8c28d25560 before pre-promotion qualification completes
promotion must preserve the exact five qualified production blobs
F-MR41 remains owner of typed optional-state layout identities
no large-batch throughput claim is made by this admission
no new groundwater-coupling capability is claimed
